item.title: Advice for the next 100 Rust GUIs
item.description:
📝 There have been roughly 20 Rust GUI toolkits announced since that blog post (see 2026 survey), but also a recent rapid acceleration of interest in Rust GUI, fueled by AI. Rust GUI is still compelling The motivation to build GUI apps in Rust remains strong. That said, there's been considerable progress in trying to build mobile UI entirely in Rust.
🔗 Read more: https://linebender.org/blog/next-100-guis/
